name: @yapaja/addon-sdk
description: The add-on author SDK (E09-T2/T3/T4, docs/05 §3): the UNTRUSTED, add-on-side client for BOTH add-on kinds -- a postMessage client for UI add-ons (sandboxed iframe) and a REST+WS client for service add-ons (Core-spawned child process / external container) -- plus the postMessage wire protocol the UI transport and the host (apps/web/src/addons) agree on. The REAL scope enforcement always lives host/Core-side; this package is a convenience layer only.
